units.name: Operations and Supply Chain Management
units.evidence: Official page calls this academic specialization and identifies supply-chain network design, facility layout/location, operations strategy and logistics among research strengths, with dedicated faculty and area contact.

decisions.reason: Official name retained but accurately typed as academic area rather than department.

sources.note: Academic area title, scope and faculty.
